newsitem.title: FINLAND: Metra proposes one-for-one bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Metra proposes one-for-one bonus issue.

text.p: Finnish diversified engineering group Metra Oy Ab said in a statement on Wednesday it would double its share capital to 1.08 billion markka through a one-for-one bonus issue.

The board will propose to the annual general meeting on March 24 a bonus issue "by giving shareholders without charge one new series B share with a nominal value of 20 markka for each series A share and one new series B share with a nominal value of 20 markka for each series B share," Metra said.
An amount corresponding to the share capital increase would be moved to the share capital from the company's reserve fund, it said.
Currently, Metra's share capital is 538.7 billion markka.
